requires.label: Colorado resident
requires.quote: if your family income is at or below four times the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) for Resident of the State of Colorado.

requires.label: Emergency or medically necessary care
requires.quote: UCHealth provides financial assistance for emergency and other medically necessary care

requires.label: Uninsured or underinsured
requires.quote: If you do not have insurance or if you are under-insured, UCHealth provides financial assistance

rules.label: Free care up to 250% FPL
rules.quote: Annual family income up to 250% of the FPG: free care

rules.label: Discounted care 251%-400% FPL
rules.quote: Annual family income between 251% and 400% of the FPG: discounted care equal to or less than the Amount Generally Billed

rules.label: Catastrophic balance discount
rules.quote: If you have a single account balance that is greater than 50% of your total annual family income and certain other financial resources, you may be eligible for a discount to your bill.

notes: Lawful presence status is not counted in determining residency status.

Charges Will Not Exceed Amount Generally Billed: If you are eligible to receive financial assistance under UCHealth’s FAP, UCHealth will not charge you more for emergency or other medically necessary care than the amount UCHealth generally bills patients with commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid coverage.
Additional measures may be applied for catastrophic encounters.
The policy does not specify timing for application submission, ECA restrictions, or payment plan details.
req_co_resident may leave out a condition: Policy limits assistance to Colorado residents but also requires lack of insurance or being underinsured.
req_care_type may leave out a condition: Policy requires emergency or medically necessary care but also requires lack of insurance or being underinsured.
req_insurance_status may leave out a condition: Policy requires lack of insurance or being underinsured but also requires emergency or medically necessary care.
rule_catastrophic may leave out a condition: Policy requires balance >50% of income AND certain other financial resources, not just income threshold.

dropped.claim: A patient with (fpl_pct >= 251) AND (fpl_pct <= 400) gets an unstated amount of help
dropped.quote: Annual family income between 251% and 400% of the FPG: discounted care equal to or less than the Amount Generally Billed
dropped.why: Policy specifies discount is equal to or less than AGB, not an unstated amount.
